Class StatsManager

java.lang.Object
model.StatsManager
public class StatsManager extends Object
Handles the game stats, saved in a txt file, and updates them.

    • StatsManager

      public StatsManager()
      When intialising the StatsManager, if a stats file is already present, it loads its contents. If there isn't one, it creates an empty map.

    • retrieveFromFile

      public Map<String,Integer> retrieveFromFile()
      Retrieves stats data from a file. It extracts the high score holder, the fastest completionist, high score, total deaths, kills and victories.
      Returns:
      a map containing each stat and its value
